title: Military
desc: Madhavan is known as Military due to his strict attitude towards his five sisters. However, when he is forced to get his first sister married to a widowed professor, his other sisters alienate him.

title: Melmaruvathur Arpudhangal
desc: A devout woman marries a religious man, expecting a life of shared faith. However, her life collapses when her husband makes a grave accusation of her unfaithfulness.

title: Marupadiyum
desc: Thulasi's life turns upside down when she finds her husband having an illicit affair.

title: Anjali
desc: Chitra who thought her child is dead, learns that she is still alive and dealing with a cognitive disorder. However, her family is facing several challenges while raising her.

title: Thimiru
desc: A medical student saves the life of a professor and his daughter. When the girl falls in love with him, she discovers that his tragic past has been haunting him.
